name: Kadesh
overview: Kadesh, also known as Kadesh-Barnea, is a significant location on the southern boundary of ancient Palestine where key biblical events unfolded. It was near the wells where Abraham sojourned, highlighting its importance as a place of provision and rest (Genesis 16:14; 20:1). The city was also a strategic encampment site for Israel during their wilderness journey, where they assessed the Promised Land (Numbers 13:26; 20:1). Additionally, Kadesh experienced conflict, including being struck down by Chedorlaomer, demonstrating the challenges faced in the region (Genesis 14:7).
